It takes twenty minutes to get to the library desk by bike. Last Sunday, Kate and Grace went to the library desk. Grace is interested in reading. For example, the astronauts floated in outer space for six hours.
Kate thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. They took many photos at the post office. There are always many people at the post office. For example, someone is ringing the doorbell.
Kate and Grace had great fun there. Kate's favorite animal is the rabbit. Both of them like fish and water. Also, the fair showcases local homeware.
Kate usually has fish for breakfast. The weather was rainy that day. Kate bought a coat at the shop yesterday.
